trigger.description: A mesh approval bearer authenticates successfully, but its 15-minute lifetime elapsed or its canonical preview no longer matches the current target, grant generation, policy generations, complete revision-pinned candidate set, sample parameters, exact redacted sample, or caution set. The grant fails closed before mutation and returns no replacement bearer.
setup_commands: issue an approval bearer with ee mesh preview-grant peer_example123 --lane body --issue-approval-token --workspace . --json in a bounded fixture harness
advance the target generation with ee mesh revoke-lane peer_example123 --lane body --workspace . --json
trigger.invocation: printf '%s\n' '<previous-authentic-bearer>' | ee mesh grant peer_example123 --lane body --preview-token-stdin --workspace . --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Run the read-only lane preview again and submit its new approval token through bounded stdin.
